Package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity

Class User

java.lang.Object
edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
UserWithContent
public class User extends Object
The User class represents a user entity in the application's database. It is annotated with @Entity to map this class to the "user" table in the SQLite database. The table includes an index on the "oauth_key" column, ensuring unique values for that key. The class defines the following main fields: - id: A unique identifier for each user, auto-generated when a user record is created. - displayName: The display name of the user, stored as a case-insensitive value. - oauthKey: A unique identifier for OAuth authentication, stored as a case-insensitive value. - created: A timestamp indicating when the user entity was created. Getters and setters are provided for accessing and modifying each of these fields. This class is designed to work seamlessly with Room for database management.
